road.appearance: Muted worn asphalt, no copied road markings or snow.

mainBore.sectionBasis: USACE 2012 engineering text gives variable curved walls and constrictions about 20 ft/16 ft. Nominal width/height, spring profile, lining and location/extent of a constriction are estimates. A complete hollow tube and continuous floor are required, with both ends open.

galleries.sectionBasis: Long concrete avalanche-protection canopies are confirmed by USACE. Whole northern/southern native centerlines establish approximate plan lengths. Roof slab, uphill retaining wall and open valley bays with concrete supports use estimated engineering sections/census; no per-bay survey claim. Uphill side may be selected from the unchanged original field before geometry, never by later rendering fit.

north.basis: Named Army 2009/2011 portal photographs: true rectangular entry under transverse beam, tall blocklike flanking piers and horizontal relief courses. All sizes and hidden returns estimated. No banner, insignia, graffiti, traffic or snow copied.

south.basis: Unphotographed end represented as a conservative concrete portal around the same complete bore. Exact facade/profile/returns are explicit estimates; not a claim of identical north/south ornament or current reconstruction.

geometryBasis: Whole Salang Tunnel in a coherent approximate 2011 appearance: complete named main bore and both intrinsic northern and southern avalanche galleries along all original mapped centerline controls; both tunnel ends, continuous road floor, lining/roof, concrete gallery roof/walls/open bays and structural supports, portal piers/beams and short retaining returns. Do not substitute one photographed portal for the full tunnel. Native current centerlines register the older structure approximately; precise historic gallery extents, profiles, grade, bay census and unseen southern portal details are estimated. Exclude the wider pass highway, unrelated culverts, natural mountain body, vehicles, soldiers, snow, signage and later 2013/2023 reconstruction finishes.
